name: Lisa Blunt Rochester
summary: Lisa LaTrelle Blunt Rochester (née Blunt; born February 10, 1962), also known as LBR, is an American politician and former management consultant serving as the junior United States senator from Delaware, a seat she has held since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as the U.S. representative for Delaware's at-large congressional district from 2017 to 2025. Blunt Rochester is the first woman and first African American to represent Delaware in both chambers of Congress.
